items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: I know you worked with Sharkey for years

ctx.x: Anything else, else about some of the later jobs you've played? I know you worked with Sharkey for years and of course you worked with Johnny on that job when you recorded. You just got back from Nix, I understand. From Nix, yeah, New York.
We were, we were there, I'd say, well, I worked there about two and a half, three months.
